formats.key: Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Once anyone submits the signed permit before the deadline, the token's allowance from owner to spender is set to exactly `value` (ERC20PermitUpgradeable.permit → _approve(owner, spender, value)). This replaces any earlier allowance.
The owner's permit nonce goes up by one (_useNonce), so this signature cannot be replayed.
The signature is valid only while block.timestamp <= deadline.
formats.shown: "Authorize spending of tokens" with the spender (raw address), the max spending amount in this token ("Unlimited" at 2^255 or more), the valid-until date and the owner. The nonce is hidden.

findings.title: Permit has no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line names neither the spender nor the amount.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json display.formats Permit: "intent": "Authorize spending of tokens" with no interpolatedIntent. The spender and value fields are always visible and could go in the sentence.
findings.fix: Add "interpolatedIntent": "Allow {spender} to spend up to {value} until {deadline}".
